title: The 5 Best Juicers Under $100
metaDescription: Our 5 picks for juicers under $100, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at juicers under $100 using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: NutriBullet Juicer Pro NBJ50200
products.blurb: Key specs: 1000W high-torque motor, 27oz sealing juice pitcher, 3-inch feed chute with dual-size pusher.
strengths: 1000W motor is strong for the price, handling most fruits and vegetables without bogging down
Dishwasher-safe parts and a wide feed chute keep everyday use simple
limitations: Lower yield on leafy greens and celery than pricier masticating juicers
Some owners report excess foam on high-water-content produce
Motor noise is more noticeable relative to its output than pricier models

products.name: Hamilton Beach Big Mouth 800W Juicer (67702)
strengths: Easy to clean parts and included brush
limitations: Centrifugal design yields less from leafy greens

products.name: Hamilton Beach Juice & Blend 2-in-1 Juicer and Blender (67970)
strengths: Juicer and personal blender in one
Travel lid for the blender jar
limitations: Centrifugal juicing is less efficient with greens

products.name: Hamilton Beach Big Mouth 2-Speed Juicer (67750)
strengths: Two speeds for soft and hard produce

howWeChose: Picks are based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. We don't claim our own testing.
We do not list prices or star ratings because they change. Check Amazon for current details.
